_doc: Hồng Lô Cốc's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Input to tools/design/combat_sim/put_effects.py under source world-depth:hong_lo. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/hong_lo.items.json.

It Does Not Cool.rule: Nine-Year Ember: your Burn stacks on a foe wait when the foe evades any of your strikes (refreshed to at least 6 s); once a fight, when a cleanse puts out more than 5 of your Burn stacks, the ember restores them (8 s).
It Does Not Cool.approx: Fight pauses already freeze debuff timers via stop_clock; hiding/evasion is modelled on was_evaded refreshing Burn batches to 6 s, and putting out Burn by a Water hit is modelled on cleansed with amount > 5.

Quench the Jacket.rule: Snow-Melt Gourd: when you take Fire damage (once every 2 s), you gain 1 Water buff stack for 10 s; while you hold 3 or more Water buff stacks, your own Burn stacks on you are cleansed 1 every 2 s.
Quench the Jacket.approx: Incoming debuff duration halving is not a live mod key, so periodic 2 s Fire cleanse while holding 3+ Water buff stacks models Burn ending twice as fast (following The Robe Is Never Dry).

Ký Tế.rule: Water Over Fire, full set (3 pieces): your Burn stacks on the foe are refreshed to at least 4 s whenever you are healed, and each heal art you cast turns 1 Burn stack on the foe into a steam burst of Fire damage equal to 3 s of that Burn (0.06 c Fire free hit).
Ký Tế.approx: 3 s of 1 Burn stack (0.019 c/s) is expressed as a 0.06 c Fire free hit.

A Second Early.rule: Snow Hearth, full set (2 pieces): each time a steam art spends Burn stacks (your Burn stacks spent by Steam from the Jacket), you heal 2 % of your health for each stack spent. Pill timing awaits the Alchemy pass.
A Second Early.approx: Pills acting a second sooner is unmodelled until pills have fight timers (Alchemy pass); 'your own Burn stacks' reads your Burn stacks consumed by a steam art (steam-from-the-jacket).
